channel_id_note: Matches channels/{{channel_id}}.json, which points here via its `stance` field.

decided_by.note: Nobody has decided this channel's position yet: the file is the empty skeleton of the factory's template (shared/channel_template/stance.json, CC-0008), created from the command center on {{created}}.

position.thesis_note: What every video of the channel does, in one sentence - the channel's frame. Written by a person (a grill), applied by the machine to every video.

left_open: The whole position: the frame, what is out of it, the voice, what the fact is, the refusal, the declaration. A channel with a pipeline needs every part its consumers read (tests/test_channel_stance.py REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL); a channel without one does not yet.
note: CC-0008: the template's skeleton. Fill it in from the command center's editor (the «Позиция» part of the channel).
